threepl.simulator

Class SimFloat

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.simulator.SimValue
      • threepl.simulator.SimNumber
        • threepl.simulator.SimFloat
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Cloneable, TDEConstants, Constant, SimTypes

    public class SimFloat
extends SimNumber
    A SimFloat is a SimNumber containing a floating point number of arbitrary mantissa and exponent precision. It may be created as a FLOAT type.
    Version:
    $Revision: 6003 $
    Author:
    Andrew Tulloh
